title: Magical place
text: The whole visit was incredible!! And without a doubt, it's always a pleasure to return to this magical place.
author: S3241YOcristianr

title: It saved us!
text: We bought it on a Saturday afternoon for Monday's visit. We were afraid because of some reviews but the confirmation arrived the next day, perfectly on time for the visit on Monday. It is true, I think we paid triple (if I am not mistaken the original price is about €12), but honestly it was worth it since we left it for the last minute and there were no tickets anywhere, so they saved us and the visit to the Alhambra is worth that and more!!
author: Carmen_P
